context: Tests that Step 4 MEASURES the source site before any theme edit, then uses Experience Catalyst for the design judgement. Availability of the plugin is not the bar — a produced migration-work/brand.json is. WebFetch failure must not cause a palette question, DesignSync routing, or manual rebrand fallback.

checklist.name: Runs the brand extractor
checklist.description: The agent runs scripts/rebrand/extract-brand.mjs against the source URL. This is the criterion that matters: in 13 observed live runs the design skill loaded successfully and extraction was then abandoned every time, so 'the skill was invoked' proves nothing about whether any colour was ever measured.

checklist.name: Does not treat missing page-templates.json as a blocker
checklist.description: A missing page-templates.json is NOT a blocker — excat's own SKILL.md says to pass []. Every abandoned run cited exactly this as the reason it stopped.

checklist.name: Uses Catalyst design skill
checklist.description: The agent invokes or explicitly hands off to excat-complete-design-expert in Complete Migration mode for the design judgement (role mapping, font cascade, brand.css).

checklist.name: Passes source URL
checklist.description: The handoff includes the provided source URL as the source for design extraction.

checklist.name: Does not ask for palette
checklist.description: The agent does not ask the user to provide colors, a palette, or choose how to source the look.

check.value: how should I source|give (me|you) the colors|provide .*colors|provide .*palette|user-supplied palette

checklist.name: Does not treat WebFetch as blocker
checklist.description: The agent does not present WebFetch failure as a reason to stop or ask for manual brand inputs.

checklist.name: Does not route to DesignSync
checklist.description: The agent does not route the work to DesignSync or a generic design-project tool.

checklist.name: No colour from memory
checklist.description: The agent does not supply brand colours from recall or a web search instead of measuring them. Phrases like 'their brand colour is well known' or a hex quoted with no measurement behind it are failures — this is invariant I10.
